headline: Approved previous meeting minutes unanimously; discussed Howard Center outreach services and Comprehensive Plan event planning.
summary: Members heard a presentation from the Howard Center Community Outreach Team about its work, staffing, and calls it receives. The group also discussed ideas to draw more participants to the 8/27 Comprehensive Plan Rewrite public event at the Senior Center. The only recorded vote was approval of the previous meeting minutes.
decisions: Approved the previous meeting minutes unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Approve Previous Meeting Minutes Motion by: Marielle Matthews Second: Carly Schneider Approved Unanimous

plain_text:
8/12/2026 - Minutes
Call to Order
Names of Members Present: Marielle Matthews, Courtney Blasius, Carly Schneider, Dana Howe
Name of City Council Liaison Present: Bryn Oakleaf
Name of Staff Liaison Present: Chief Justin Huizenga, Ray Coffey
Names of Guests Present: Liam and Rob from Howard Center Community Outreach Team
Call to Order by: Marielle Matthews
Meeting Start Time: 5:40 PM
Minutes Recorded by: Marielle Matthews
Public Comment
Marielle shared information about the upcoming Friendship Festival
Approve Previous Meeting Minutes
Motion by: Marielle Matthews
Second: Carly Schneider
Approved
Unanimous
Presentation from Howard Center Community Outreach Team
-Rob, Howard Center Community Outreach, 5 years
-Liam, Howard Center Community Outreach, 12 years
-Community Outreach serves many towns
-MH first responders, mostly getting calls from Police, EMS, Fire, but also gets calls from the 
public via a hotline
-Community Outreach works with First Call (another program of Howard Center)
-First Call can initiate involuntary hospitalization - First Call is usually the responder when there 
is danger
-Community Outreach has access both to Valcour and EHR of Howard Center
-Full staff is 6; current staffing is 4
-Chief H asked about trends at the county level, Liam responded that he sees mostly the same 
things- co-occurring SUD and MH issues that result in homelessness
-getting more calls about dementia related issues lately- they feel that older folks are being 
underserved
-they’re hoping they can get a van, Bryn expressed interest in trying to fund a capital campaign, 
Marielle suggested opioid settlement fund
-they are frequently using MHUC on Sout Prospect
-Chief H mentioned that sometimes Dept of Mental Health doesn’t permit an admission of a 
person, even when Police and UVM and Howard clinicians all want admission
-Hoarding is a big issue among clients and is something that could use more resources. CHT 
used to have a hoarding specialist and we haven’t been able
-CSWD has community clean up funds - Bryn mentioned tends to be towns further from the 
Burlington core
-can take referrals through team email for non-urgent issues, rather than phone 
calls Communityoutreach@howardcenter.org (not for clients, but for providers, community 
partners, etc.)
Comprehensive Plan Rewrite Public Event Planning
The group discussed potential ideas to draw more participants to the upcoming 8/27 event at 
the Senior Center.
Inclusion and Belonging Commission Liaison Updates
N/A
City Council and City Staff Liaison Updates
Other Business
N/A
Adjourn
Motion by: Courtney Blasius
Second: Dana Howe
Meeting End Time: 7:05 PM
